landing.coverage.lead: Greater Cairo today. Your area decides your collection window and what delivery costs.
landing.coverage.outside_body: We are still adding areas. Get in touch and tell us where you are.
landing.coverage.title: Areas we collect from
landing.coverage.windows_body: Pick the window that suits you when you book. A driver on a route cannot promise a minute, so we commit to a window and tell you when they are on the way.
landing.cta.lead: Book a collection, see the count, approve the price. In that order.
landing.cta.note: Cancel free of charge until the driver arrives.
landing.cta.title: Your next wash, priced before it happens
landing.facts.cash: Pay cash when it comes back
landing.faq.a1: Your laundry counts the bag piece by piece and prices each one from the published list on this page. That itemised count and its total come to you for approval, and cleaning starts only when you approve it.
landing.faq.a2: Ask for a recount. The bag is counted again and comes back to you with a fresh list. It costs nothing, and there is no limit on how many times you can ask.
landing.faq.a3: Then nothing is washed. The order waits. It is not cleaned, not charged for, and not quietly pushed through on your behalf.
landing.faq.a4: When your order is handed back to you. You pay the driver in cash at your door, after your clothes are with you.
landing.faq.a5: Free of charge any time before the driver has taken the bag. After that the order runs to the end — but you still approve the price before anything is washed.
landing.faq.a6: It depends on the service, and each one's turnaround is listed above. The clock starts when you approve the price, not when the bag leaves your door.
landing.faq.a7: No. Every item is priced individually from a published list, which is what makes the count something you can check.
landing.faq.q1: How is the final price decided?
landing.faq.q2: What if I disagree with the count?
landing.faq.q3: What if I never approve it?
landing.faq.q7: Do you wash by the kilo?
landing.faq.title: The things people ask first
landing.features.f1_body: Choose your collection and delivery window when you book, and change it later if your day changes.
landing.features.f2_body: Hand the bag over in person or have it left at your door — and choose differently for the collection and the return.
landing.features.f3_body: See which step your order is on and where your driver is when they are on their way to you.
landing.features.f4_body: Every movement is listed — what you paid, what was added, what was refunded. The balance is the sum of the list, not a number you have to take on trust.
landing.features.f5_body: Set a weekly or monthly rhythm and we will ask before each one. Nothing is ever collected because a schedule said so.
landing.features.f6_body: Share your code and you both get a discount once their first order is paid for.
landing.features.title: Small things that make it easier
landing.footer.tagline: Laundry collected from your door, counted in the open, and priced before a single piece is washed.
landing.hero.card_example_note: An example, priced from our live price list.
landing.hero.card_note: Cleaning does not begin until you approve.
landing.hero.lead: We collect from your door, count every piece one by one, and send you the final price. Then it is your call — approve it, or ask us to count again.
landing.hero.pill: Cleaning starts only once you approve the price
landing.hero.title: Nothing gets washed before you approve the price
landing.journey.branch_note: Asked for a recount instead? The order returns to the laundry and comes back to you with a fresh count.
landing.journey.gate_note: The order stops here. Nothing moves past this step without your approval.
landing.journey.lead: You can follow every step of it in the app, live.
landing.journey.legs_body: Your driver collects from you, delivers to the laundry, collects the finished order and brings it back. Each handover is confirmed with a scan, and a signature at your door.
landing.journey.title: From your door and back again
landing.legal.empty: This page has not been published yet.
landing.offers.title: Current offers
landing.partner.driver_body: Collections and deliveries around the areas you choose, on the shift you set. Earnings are recorded per completed journey with the arithmetic shown, so you can always see how a figure was reached.
landing.partner.laundry_body: Take orders without buying vans or building an app. You choose which services you offer and which areas you cover; we handle the customers, the drivers and the prices. You get a panel showing your queue, your ratings and what you have earned.
landing.prices.delivery_body: Charged by distance between your address and the laundry, with a minimum for your area. Collecting from one address and delivering to another counts as two journeys.
landing.prices.lead: This is the same list your order is priced from. It is the platform's list, not each laundry's — so the price does not depend on which one your bag goes to.
landing.prices.payment_body: Cash when your order comes back to you. You pay after your clothes are in your hands, never before.
landing.prices.payment_soon: In-app payment is on the way. Until it is live, cash on delivery is how every order is settled.
landing.prices.table_caption: Price per piece by service, in :currency
landing.prices.title: The whole price list, in public
landing.problem.lead: By the time a number reaches you, the work is finished and there is nothing left to discuss.
landing.problem.point_1_body: The bag goes out and a total comes back. Agreeing to it is not really a choice once the clothes are already clean.
landing.problem.point_1_title: You find out at the end
landing.problem.point_2_body: You remember nine shirts, the ticket says eleven, and neither side has anything to check it against.
landing.problem.point_3_body: No itemised list, no record of what was charged for what, and nothing to point at when something is missing.
landing.problem.point_3_title: A hand-written ticket is not a receipt
landing.problem.title: Most laundry is priced after it has already been washed
landing.promise.beat_1_body: Your driver records the pieces at your door. The laundry counts them again on arrival, item by item.
landing.promise.beat_2_body: Each piece is priced from the same published list you can read on this page. No per-bag guesswork, no per-kilo estimates.
landing.promise.beat_3_body: The itemised count and the final total arrive in the app. You approve it, or you send it back to be counted again.
landing.promise.beat_4_body: Only your approval releases the work. Until then nothing has been washed and nothing has been charged.
landing.promise.lead: Four steps, always in that order. The third one is yours.
landing.promise.title: We count it. We price it. You approve it. Then we wash it.
landing.review.cancel_note: And before any of this: you can cancel free of charge right up until the driver takes the bag.
landing.review.confirm_body: The price you approved is the price you pay. It is copied onto your order and a later change to our price list cannot reach it.
landing.review.dispute_body: The bag goes back to be counted again and returns to you with a fresh list. There is no limit on asking, and no charge for it.
landing.review.item_1_body: Not a total. A list — what was found, how many of each, and the price applied to it.
landing.review.item_2_body: What you entered when you booked, next to what the laundry actually found, and the difference between them.
landing.review.item_3_body: Two buttons, and the order does not move until you press one of them.
landing.review.lead: When your laundry has counted the bag, the order stops and waits for you. This is the step the whole service is built around.
landing.review.question_body: Not sure about a line? Ask about it and the order simply waits where it is until somebody answers you.
landing.review.title: You see the count before you see the bill
landing.seo.description: Laundry collected from your door across Cairo and Giza. We count every piece, send you the final price, and wash nothing until you have approved it.
landing.seo.og_image_alt: Laundo — laundry collection and delivery in Cairo and Giza
landing.seo.title: Laundo — laundry priced before it is washed
landing.services.lead: Turnaround times are what the laundry commits to once your price is approved.
landing.services.quote: Priced once we have seen it
landing.services.quote_note: Bulky items are quoted after inspection rather than from a fixed list — and that quote goes through the same approval as everything else.
landing.services.title: Our services
